memories.title: The pragma busy_timeout must be the first statement on a connection.
memories.body: Otherwise the first query fails at once with SQLITE_BUSY.

memories.title: Fixed: `PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL` does not honour busy_timeout.
memories.body: Processes creating the database together retry by hand in `enableWal`.

memories.title: Never mock the database in these tests.
memories.body: Always use a real SQLite file in a temporary directory.

memories.title: Turns open at the prompt event, not at turn end.
memories.body: Interrupted turns never get a Stop event, so opening late loses them.

memories.title: A hook must never exit with code 2.
memories.body: Claude Code treats exit code 2 as a request to block the user's action.

memories.title: Linux and Windows x64 builds use the baseline Bun runtime.
memories.body: The default runtime needs AVX2 and dies with Illegal instruction on older CPUs.

memories.title: A compiled Bun binary loads .env from the working directory by default.
memories.body: The build passes --no-compile-autoload-dotenv so a hook never reads the user's secrets.

memories.title: Fixed: full-text search now folds diacritics.
memories.body: The FTS5 table uses the unicode61 tokenizer with remove_diacritics 2.

memories.title: Full-text queries use CROSS JOIN to pin the join order.
memories.body: Otherwise the planner probes the FTS index once per memory row, a hundred times slower.

memories.title: Commit messages are written in English and follow conventional commits.
Retrieval uses FTS5 with BM25 and no embeddings in the first version.
memories.body: Vectors would need a model download and an extra process; recall measurements decide later.

memories.title: The MCP server uses @modelcontextprotocol/server 2.x, loaded only by the mcp command.
memories.body: Hooks must never pay the import cost of the SDK.

memories.title: Text is redacted before it is cut to size.
memories.body: Cutting first could leave half a secret unrecognised.

memories.title: Only one process drains the distill queue at a time, under a lease in the meta table.
As respostas ao utilizador são sempre em português.
memories.body: Termos técnicos e identificadores ficam na forma original.

memories.title: O importador do claude-mem só lê a base de dados do próprio utilizador.
memories.body: É interoperabilidade de dados, não reutilização de código.

memories.title: O Cursor não permite injetar contexto na submissão do prompt.
memories.body: Só o evento sessionStart aceita additional_context; o resto fica por MCP.

memories.title: The status command gained a --json flag.
memories.body: It prints the same fields as the table view as one JSON object.

memories.title: Claude Code identifies a turn by prompt_id in the UserPromptSubmit and Stop payloads.
memories.body: The same id is written on the user lines of the transcript.

memories.title: Fixed: a pending timer kept the process alive for ten seconds.
memories.body: Promise.race with Bun.sleep leaves the sleep running; the `within` helper clears the timer.

memories.title: Imports carry an explicit .ts extension.
The settings file is backed up before install changes it.
memories.body: Uninstall restores the original bytes when nothing else changed since.

memories.title: No macOS o Bun usa o SQLite do sistema, cuja versão varia.
memories.body: Por isso as tabelas não usam STRICT.

memories.title: Hook latency is recorded in the hook_runs table, without payloads.
memories.body: The table is pruned to the last 2000 rows after each drain.
